source_description: No original producer-execution witness source is available for G0.7 attempt g07-mainnet-attempt-1-dry-20261015T222241Z: there is no access to the block producer (validator or builder) that executes the [launch_A, buy_B] bundle, so producer-side T0/T_buy completion brackets, producer clock_id, boot identity and uncertainty metadata conforming to bsc/config/producer_execution_witness_v1.schema.json are not available for this attempt. T0_TO_BUY therefore remains UNKNOWN (UNKNOWN_PENDING_ORIGINAL_PRODUCER_WITNESS); the strict T0->T_buy < 1000000 ns timing gate cannot pass for this attempt (t0_exact=false); a timing PASS would require a newly instrumented attempt with an original producer witness. Canonical inclusion of the BUY at position N+1 directly after the launch at position N proves ordering and adjacency only and is not sub-millisecond timing evidence. Local send/flush brackets, builder responses, receipt observation times, block header timestamps and any retroactive re-execution or EVM trace are not producer execution timestamps. Acquisition and ordering are evaluated separately by G0.8.
